question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

BEARD : FTCGD : : CROWN : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e1e96d51b86d15421868a13329a263f32ed0009588559b082c8ac26d64b3fe09.png] 

Logic : Each letter's position value + (2) , then reverse the order.

So,

 
• BEARD is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c78eb96e334439f80b92a90a0a1c7b4c5687263d51d312fb8bc59f60770eb7b7.png] ​

Similarly, 

 
• CROWN is coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4214f54358be8998d6e71dbb00d1fb6c02766e32f1387de1a85eb4a5501ce9f1.png] ​
